description: Comment “Truth” and I’ll send you the prompt 👇 A Stanford study just found that ChatGPT agrees with you 49% more than a human does. Here’s one prompt that forces it to stop being a yes-man. It’s called the ChatGPT Council. Just say “Ask the Council” before any question and ChatGPT spins up 5 advisor agents that attack your question from completely different angles: • Contrarian — finds the flaw in whatever you said • First Principles Thinker — ignores your question and figures out what you’re actually trying to solve • Expansionist — finds the upside everyone else missed • Outsider — given zero context so it catches the obvious stuff • Executor — doesn’t care about theory, only what you should do next ChatGPT then runs all their answers through 5 peer review agents and a Chairman synthesizes everything into one final verdict. This stops ChatGPT from agreeing with everything so you actually get the truth. #chatgpt #ai #chatgptprompts #aitools #chatgpttips
